findings.text: D1: Arbiscan name-tag search surfaced PGOLD token at 0x3e76bb02286bfeaa89dd35f11253f2cbce634f91 (Arbitrum One) labelled 'Pleasing Gold (PGOLD) | ERC-20 | Real World Assets'. A 'Pleasing Golden: VIP Account' address (0x0fd63e5735204f506b6b44d349c3f3bebe4d3845) appeared in a search snippet holding PGOLD and PUSD — snippet only, not full fetch (D8). No ApeChain explorer was accessible; ApeChain addresses remain unknown.

D2: Gitbook docs at https://pleasing.gitbook.io/docs/ fetched; no canonical deployed-contracts page found in the available pages. The docs site references website https://www.pleasingmarket.com/ and dapp https://dapp.pleasingmarket.com/ but no addresses table was accessible within fetch budget. deployed_contracts_doc set to null.

D3: No audit links provided in protocol.audit_links and none surfaced in fetched docs or Arbiscan submission page. Arbiscan contract page shows 'No Contract Security Audit Submitted'. audits array is empty.
D4: No GitHub repo provided in protocol.github and none discovered via fetched sources. No deployment artifacts, broadcast files, or address indexes found.

D5: Press releases and docs confirm deployments on Arbitrum and ApeChain. Arbitrum PGOLD proxy address confirmed via Arbiscan fetch. ApeChain explorer (apechain.com / apescan.io) was not fetched due to fetch budget constraints; zero ApeChain addresses surfaced from accessible sources.
D6: No factory contract identified. PGOLD and PUSD are discrete token contracts, not pool factories. No factory enumeration applicable.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: PGOLD proxy → token; PGOLD implementation → other (logic contract); VIP Account → other (fund-holding address, snippet only). Proxy admin address not yet discovered — TransparentUpgradeableProxy pattern implies a separate ProxyAdmin contract exists but its address was not returned in the fetched Arbiscan page.

D8: VIP Account 0x0fd63e5735204f506b6b44d349c3f3bebe4d3845 appeared only in a search snippet (not full fetch); placed in unknowns per D8 rules. All admin_addresses[] entries trace to full fetched sources.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked pleasinggold.com (JS-gated, minimal), Arbiscan Arbitrum for PGOLD token (full fetch), and the Gitbook docs (two pages fetched). Two on-chain addresses confirmed from fetched sources (PGOLD proxy + implementation on Arbitrum). PUSD token address, proxy admin, ApeChain contracts, and any GitHub/audit artifacts remain undiscovered.

PGOLD ERC-20 token on Arbitrum One; TransparentUpgradeableProxy (EIP-1967); implementation at 0xD81ea1E2179c983a45aa95929f189c2bd59788d7 (PGOLDToken); 19,505 PGOLD total supply; 343 holders; labelled Real World Assets; linked to pleasinggold.com.

Press release (Oct 29 2025) confirming deployments on Arbitrum and ApeChain; introduces PGOLD (gold-backed token) and PUSD (synthetic stablecoin); LayerZero + Chainlink infrastructure; Pleasing International HQ Hong Kong.

Official docs site; protocol renamed from Pleasing Golden to Pleasing Market; two products: PGOLD (physical gold token) and USDpm (formerly PUSD, ecosystem stablecoin); new website https://www.pleasingmarket.com/ and dapp https://dapp.pleasingmarket.com/; no deployed-addresses table on this page.

Spot trading mechanics: PGOLD=1 troy oz, inventory-backed (no mint/burn during spot trades), LayerZero OFT for PGOLD, Chainlink CCIP for USDpm, Chainlink Data Streams for XAU pricing; confirms USDpm renamed from PUSD.

Derived: confirms Arbitrum and ApeChain as primary deployment chains; PGOLD represents 1 oz LBMA-certified gold; PUSD synthetic stablecoin backed by USDT collateral; LayerZero omnichain framework used.

protocol_metadata.about: Pleasing Market (formerly Pleasing Golden) is an RWA platform by Pleasing International, a Hong Kong-based licensed precious-metals enterprise, that tokenizes physical gold as PGOLD — each token representing one troy ounce of LBMA-certified gold held in institutional vaults. Users can buy or sell PGOLD on-chain via a Chainlink Data Streams-powered spot market and convert to USDpm (formerly PUSD), an ecosystem stablecoin backed by USDT collateral, for stable exposure. The protocol is deployed initially on Arbitrum and ApeChain using LayerZero's omnichain framework for cross-chain interoperability. Physical redemption of allocated gold bars is supported in Hong Kong with expansion planned for APAC and Dubai.
